title: Daily fiber intake: Hadza vs US guideline vs average American

source.name: Hadza diet fiber intake; USDA Dietary Guidelines for Americans; NHANES average intake
source.publisher: Stanford/Science (Smits et al. 2017); U.S. Department of Agriculture

notes: Hadza fiber intake (~150g/day) is reported as roughly 10x the US average (~15g/day); USDA Dietary Guidelines recommend 25-38g/day (midpoint ~30g used here).
